counting_rule: Only ready fixtures with verified source and answer-key hashes count as executed evidence. Planned, unavailable, and not-applicable rows remain in every denominator.

fixtures.intended_job: Preserve a custom command and its context-dependent expansion or abstain.

expected_outcomes.positive: Preserve both call and expansion with stable locations.
expected_outcomes.negative: Block a complete-looking record that drops either representation.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when expansion cannot be resolved safely.

fixtures.intended_job: Distinguish a changed exponent from declared whitespace normalization.

expected_outcomes.positive: Classify a whitespace-only change under the declared normalization.
expected_outcomes.negative: Block an exponent change as substantive.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when the parser cannot reconstruct the equation body.

fixtures.intended_job: Expose a percentage recomputed with a different denominator.

expected_outcomes.positive: Retain the original percentage and denominator relation.
expected_outcomes.negative: Locate and block an unexplained denominator change.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when the table relation cannot be reconstructed.

fixtures.intended_job: Separate bibliographic identity from source-to-claim support.

expected_outcomes.positive: Resolve a valid identity while leaving support as a separate result.
expected_outcomes.negative: Block a missing or mismatched identity for a load-bearing claim.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain on support when full text cannot be examined.

fixtures.intended_job: Keep a population or horizon qualification linked to the proposition it limits.

expected_outcomes.positive: Preserve a qualification-proposition link across an explained move.
expected_outcomes.negative: Block a moved qualification whose scope relation is lost.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when the qualifying relation is ambiguous.

fixtures.intended_job: Locate private workflow language and connect it to the public decision the reader needs.

expected_outcomes.positive: Leave legitimate public technical vocabulary unflagged.
expected_outcomes.negative: Locate a private phase label and repository path in reader-facing prose.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when vocabulary status depends on project configuration.

fixtures.intended_job: Distinguish purposeful parallel derivation steps from mechanical repetition.

expected_outcomes.positive: Retain an intentional parallel form with the recorded reason.
expected_outcomes.negative: Locate unexplained repetitive structure when it impairs the declared task.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when intent cannot be inferred from the brief and local context.

fixtures.intended_job: Report concept bursts against declared exemplars without inventing a universal threshold.

expected_outcomes.positive: Report low-burden concept introduction with locations.
expected_outcomes.negative: Locate a concentrated concept burst that exceeds the declared comparison.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when no eligible exemplar or reader prior is supplied.

fixtures.intended_job: Check use-before-teach while respecting a declared preview exemption.

expected_outcomes.positive: Accept a term introduced after a usable expansion or declared preview.
expected_outcomes.negative: Locate the first unexplained acronym use.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when the term is plausibly part of the reader's declared vocabulary.

fixtures.intended_job: Open a review question for a newly added number, superlative, comparison, or causal claim.

expected_outcomes.positive: Retain an added assertion with a verified evidence anchor.
expected_outcomes.negative: Block silent acceptance of an unsupported new assertion.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Abstain when the cited source is unavailable for support review.

fixtures.intended_job: Compare whether a low-context reader can recover the decision and mechanism from two protected-equivalent versions.

expected_outcomes.positive: Record the reader's reconstruction, decision, time, and confidence.
expected_outcomes.negative: Record a failed or incomplete reconstruction without changing it into a machine score.
expected_outcomes.not_applicable_reason: Reader judgment is a recorded human outcome, not a deterministic parser abstention.

fixtures.intended_job: Prove the source stays read-only and writes remain inside the allowlist.

expected_outcomes.negative: Source or out-of-allowlist write is blocked.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Environment unable to enforce isolation blocks execution.

fixtures.intended_job: Prove TeX shell commands and source-tree executables cannot run.

expected_outcomes.negative: A per-run sentinel cannot be created by TeX.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Compiler flags or execution boundary cannot be verified.

fixtures.intended_job: Prove compiler and parser network access is denied.

expected_outcomes.positive: Local parsing proceeds without network authority.
expected_outcomes.negative: A connection attempt exits with the security code.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Network isolation cannot be created or observed.

fixtures.intended_job: Treat instruction-looking manuscript content as delimited data with no tool authority.

expected_outcomes.positive: Ordinary source text reaches the versioned adapter.
expected_outcomes.negative: Instruction-looking text cannot acquire tools, files, or secrets.
expected_outcomes.abstention: Adapter output fails schema or delimiter validation.

fixtures.intended_job: Enforce time, memory, file, process, and output limits.

expected_outcomes.positive: A bounded case completes and records resource use.
expected_outcomes.negative: Each seeded exhaustion aborts and names the breached limit.
expected_outcomes.abstention: A limit cannot be enforced or measured on the host.
